title: Ordinary total tensor with a scalar ring is restricted scalar extension
statement: Let (C,T) be a small site and f:R→S a map of commutative ring sheaves. Use the module sheaves and cochain complexes of [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], the ordinary signed total tensor of [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system], and the scalar extension and restriction of [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. Write B_f for the rank-one S-module restricted along f. For every unbounded R-complex P construct the specific chain isomorphism P tensor_R B_f[0] ≅ res_f(change_f(P)). It is the degree-zero contraction followed by the termwise composite of symmetry, inverse normalized tensor cancellation with the rank-one S-module, and the restricted left unitor. The module comparison is natural in module maps. No flatness, K-flatness, or boundedness is assumed.

source.place: Section tensor-product (03EK), the sheafified tensor formulas; lemma-adjointness-tensor-restrict (03CZ), scalar adjunction. For derived comparisons: sites-cohomology.tex, lemma-derived-base-change (06YY). For quotient transitions: proetale.tex, lemma-naive-completion (099M).

proof.text: Apply the proved normalized tensor cancellation to the rank-one S-module and an R-module, invert it, precede it by symmetry, and follow it by the restricted left unitor. Naturality follows by cancellation naturality, braiding naturality, and unitor naturality.

Apply CochainComplex.mapBifunctorSingle₂Iso to contract the degree-zero tensor factor. Lift the natural module comparison termwise with NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex. This is an isomorphism of complexes, not just of graded objects. These are applications of the existing totalization and termwise functor APIs.

def scalarTensorComplexIso (f : R ⟶ S) (P : Cx R) :
    ((ringedKoszulTensor R).obj P).obj
        ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).obj (scalarTensorModule f)) ≅
      ((res f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((change f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
